translations.web: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.
translations.bsb: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
translations.asv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Jehovah gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
